name: SessionCache
purpose: Stateless-tier, node-agnostic read-through cache keyed by session token for per-caller state with TTL and explicit miss/error separation.
api_signature:
from __future__ import annotations
from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any, Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable

@runtime_checkable
class SessionCache(Protocol):
    def get(self, token: str) -> Optional[Mapping[str, Any]]: ...
    def set(self, token: str, value: Mapping[str, Any], ttl_s: int) -> None: ...
    def invalidate(self, token: str) -> None: ...

invariants.rule: get() is read-only; never mutates server-side state.
Missing key returns None, not raise; caller distinguishes miss vs. error via SessionCacheError.
TTL is honored; an expired entry is equivalent to missing.
A node that has never seen a token resolves its session via the external store (cold-cache tolerant).

extension_contract: Adopters swap InMemorySessionCache for ReadThroughSessionCache passing a loader. Backend adapters (Redis/Memcached) live under core/venous/_adapters/<backend>/SessionCacheAdapter.py; the five invariants MUST be preserved. Protocol surface is sealed.
consumption_example:
cache = ReadThroughSessionCache(load_session_from_redis, ttl_s=60)
session = cache.get(token)  # None if unknown
cache.invalidate(token)     # on logout
why_essential: Without a shared session cache, either every request hits the auth store (latency) or nodes diverge on session state (correctness). SessionCache pins the contract: read-only, explicit miss/error, TTL enforced.
alternatives_considered: Per-node local-only cache — correctness hole: mutations on node A invisible on node B until TTL expiry.
Raise-on-miss API — conflates 'unknown token' with 'store down'; hides outages behind product errors.
Cache the value forever — security hole: revoked tokens continue to grant access.
